The '''ask-ar''' were one of the subspecies of the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They had [[Color/Legends|red]] markings resembling masks on their faces.<ref name="LBE">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' gives the ''ask-ar'' race the Nimble feat, suggesting there may be biological or cultural factors positively impacting the race's skills at escaping bonds and performing acts of sleight of hand.
